contribution.value: LLM-in-a-flash stores model parameters in flash and selectively loads only the active subset to DRAM using windowing and row-column bundling, enabling LLMs up to 2x DRAM size with 4-5x CPU and 20-25x GPU speedups.

ev.quote: Within this hardware-informed framework, we introduce two principal techniques. First, "windowing" strategically reduces data transfer by reusing previously activated neurons, and second, "row-column bundling", tailored to the sequential data access strengths of flash memory, increases the size of data chunks read from flash memory. These methods collectively enable running models up to twice the size of the available DRAM, with up to 4x and 20x increase in inference speed compared to naive loading approaches in CPU and GPU, respectively.

ev.quote: on OPT model, we achieve an acceleration in inference speed of 4-5x compared to traditional loading methods in CPU, and 20-25x in GPU

strengths.value: Enables running LLMs up to 2x device DRAM capacity by storing weights in flash and loading active subsets on demand.

ev.quote: These methods collectively enable running models up to twice the size of the available DRAM, with up to 4x and 20x increase in inference speed

strengths.value: Hardware-aware cost model that exploits flash sequential read advantage via row-column bundling, doubling chunk size and throughput.

ev.quote: by storing these corresponding columns and rows together in flash memory, we can consolidate the data into larger chunks for reading ... such bundling doubles the chunk size

strengths.value: Generalises across multiple architectures: OPT, Falcon, Phi-2, Persimmon, and Llama 2 all show 3-5x CPU speedups.

ev.quote: Note that the techniques introduced in this work are mostly independent of architecture

strengths.value: Low-rank activation predictor preserves zero-shot accuracy with only ~2-5% inference overhead and matches dense Arc/HellaSwag scores.

ev.quote: Table 1: The low-rank predictor has a marginal impact on zero-shot metrics as the predictor of each layer accurately identifies sparsity.

weaknesses.value: Sparse model has higher total energy consumption than dense due to longer per-token generation time, despite lower instantaneous power.

ev.quote: the extended duration required for token generation resulted in the sparse model having a higher total energy consumption

weaknesses.value: Limited to single-batch inference; multi-batch and prompt-processing scenarios are not optimised or evaluated.

ev.quote: Currently, our study is limited to single-batch inference

weaknesses.value: Method depends on sparsified networks; requires relufication finetuning for non-ReLU models such as Falcon, Phi-2, Llama 2.

ev.quote: our methodology is constructed on the foundation of sparsified networks

weaknesses.value: Co-activation bundling negative result: highly active neurons become closest friends of many, causing repeated loading.

ev.quote: bundling neurons with their highest coactivated neuron (closest friend) led to multiple loadings of highly active neurons, counteracting our goal

limitations.value: Quantization integration is left as future work; 4-bit kernels needed for smartphone deployment are out of scope.

ev.quote: actual implementation would require special 4-bit compute kernels on device, which falls outside the scope of this paper

limitations.value: No safety, jailbreak, refusal, bias, or toxicity evaluation on the sparse-loading models.

ev.quote: Our integration of sparsity awareness, context-adaptive loading, and a hardware-oriented design paves the way for effective inference of LLMs on devices with limited memory.

limitations.value: Evaluation assumes ~50% of model size in DRAM; smaller and larger memory budgets only briefly explored.

ev.quote: we operated under the assumption of memory availability being half the size of the model. Exploring the dynamics of working with varying memory sizes—both larger and smaller

limitations.value: No quantitative power or thermal measurement; only qualitative observation that sparse area-under-curve exceeds dense.

ev.quote: A systematic and quantitative evaluation of the exact power usage pattern is left as a future work.

future_work_stated.value: Systematic quantitative analysis of power consumption and thermal limitations on real on-device deployment.

ev.quote: A critical aspect for future exploration is the systematic analysis of power consumption and thermal limitations inherent in the methods we propose, particularly for on-device deployment.

future_work_stated.value: Extend method to multi-batch inference and complex prompt processing scenarios.

ev.quote: expanding this to include more complex scenarios like prompt processing and multi-batch inference are valuable areas for further investigation

future_work_stated.value: Improve activation predictor accuracy to reduce false positives and load fewer redundant neurons.

ev.quote: An interesting future direction of this work is improving the accuracy of the predictors to be able to load fewer neurons.

future_work_stated.value: Combine LLM-in-flash with quantization (4-bit) to enable 7B models on smartphones with under 2GB DRAM.
